arxiv-1808-08056.title: Independent Low-Rank Matrix Analysis Based on Time-Variant Sub-Gaussian Source Model
arxiv-1808-08056.creator: \authorblockN Shinichi Mogami \authorrefmark 1, Norihiro Takamune \authorrefmark 1, Daichi Kitamura \authorrefmark 2, Hiroshi Saruwatari \authorrefmark 1, Yu Takahashi \authorrefmark 3, Kazunobu Kondo \authorrefmark 3, Hiroaki Nakajima \authorrefmark 3, and Nobutaka Ono \authorrefmark 4 \authorblock
arxiv-1808-08056.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by \authorblockN Shinichi Mogami \authorrefmark 1, Norihiro Takamune \authorrefmark 1, Daichi Kitamura \authorrefmark 2, Hiroshi Saruwatari \authorrefmark 1, Yu Takahashi \authorrefmark 3, Kazunobu Kondo \authorrefmark 3, Hiroaki Nakajima \authorrefmark 3, and Nobutaka Ono \authorrefmark 4 \authorblock. Independent low-rank matrix analysis (ILRMA) is a fast and stable method for blind audio source separation. Conventional ILRMAs assume time-variant (super-)Gaussian source models, which can only represent signals that follow a super-Gaussian distribution.

arxiv-2104-10138.title: Coherent phonon spectroscopy and interlayer modulation of charge density wave order in the kagome metal CsV 3 Sb 5
arxiv-2104-10138.creator: Noah Ratcliff, Lily Hallett, Brenden R. Ortiz, Stephen D. Wilson, John W. Harter
arxiv-2104-10138.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Noah Ratcliff, Lily Hallett, Brenden R. Ortiz, Stephen D. Wilson, John W. Harter. The recent discovery of the A A V 3 Sb 5 ( A = A= K, Rb, Cs) material family offers an exciting opportunity to investigate the interplay of correlations, topology, and superconductivity in kagome metals. The low energy physics of these materials is dominated by an unusual charge density wave phase, but little is understood about the true nature of the order parameter.

arxiv-2203-07866.title: Demonstrating the Concept of Parallax with James Webb Space Telescope
arxiv-2203-07866.creator: Chow-Choong Ngeow, Harsh Kumar, Varun Bhalerao
arxiv-2203-07866.description: Abstract We measured the parallax of the James Webb Space Telescope based on near simultaneous observations using the Lulin One-meter Telescope and the GROWTH India Telescope, separated at a distance of ∼ 4214 \sim 4214 km. This serves a great demonstration for the concept of parallax commonly taught in introductory astronomy courses.

arxiv-2406-07797.title: Dynamic Beam-Stabilized, Additive-Printed Flexible Antenna Arrays with On-Chip Rapid Insight Generation
arxiv-2406-07797.creator: Sreeni Poolakkal, Abdullah Islam, Arpit Rao, Shrestha Bansal, Ted Dabrowski, Kalsi Kwan, Zhongxuan Wang, Amit Kumar Mishra, Julio Navarro, Shenqiang Ren, John Williams, Sudip Shekhar, Subhanshu Gupta
arxiv-2406-07797.description: Abstract Conformal phased arrays promise shape-changing properties, multiple degrees of freedom to the scan angle, and novel applications in wearables, aerospace, defense, vehicles, and ships. However, they have suffered from two critical limitations. (1) Although most applications require on-the-move communication and sensing, prior conformal arrays have suffered from dynamic deformation-induced beam pointing errors.

arxiv-2407-17388.title: A quantum analog of Huygen’s clock: noise-induced synchronization
arxiv-2407-17388.creator: Bhavay Tyagi, Hao Li, Eric R. Bittner, Andrei Piryatinski, Carlos Silva-Acuña
arxiv-2407-17388.description: Abstract We propose a quantum analogue of the Huygens clock, in which the phases of two spins achieve synchronization through their interaction with a shared environment. The environment functions analogously to the escapement mechanism in a mechanical clock, regulating the gear train and permitting the advancement of timing in discrete intervals.

arxiv-2410-04241.title: Adaptive Question Answering: Enhancing Language Model Proficiency for Addressing Knowledge Conflicts with Source Citations
arxiv-2410-04241.creator: Sagi Shaier, Ari Kobren, Philip V. Ogren
arxiv-2410-04241.description: Abstract Resolving knowledge conflicts is a crucial challenge in Question Answering (QA) tasks, as the internet contains numerous conflicting facts and opinions. While some research has made progress in tackling ambiguous settings where multiple valid answers exist, these approaches often neglect to provide source citations, leaving users to evaluate the factuality of each answer.

arxiv-2411-16926.title: Context-Aware Input Orchestration for Video Inpainting
arxiv-2411-16926.creator: Hoyoung Kim, Azimbek Khudoyberdiev, Seonghwan Jeong, Jihoon Ryoo
arxiv-2411-16926.description: Abstract Traditional neural network-driven inpainting methods struggle to deliver high-quality results within the constraints of mobile device processing power and memory. Our research introduces an innovative approach to optimize memory usage by altering the composition of input data. Typically, video inpainting relies on a predetermined set of input frames, such as neighboring and reference frames, often limited to five-frame sets.

arxiv-2501-11352.title: A mixed finite elements approximation of inverse source problems for the wave equation with variable coefficients using observability
arxiv-2501-11352.creator: Carlos Castro, Sorin Micu
arxiv-2501-11352.description: Abstract We consider an inverse problem for the linear one-dimensional wave equation with variable coefficients consisting in determining an unknown source term from a boundary observation. A method to obtain approximations of this inverse problem using a space discretization based on a mixed finite element method is proposed and analyzed.

arxiv-2501-17264.title: Constructing Simultaneous Confidence Bands for Errors-in-variables Curves with Application to the Lorenz Curve
arxiv-2501-17264.creator: Ziqing Dong, Francesco Bartolucci, Satoshi Kuriki, Antonietta Mira
arxiv-2501-17264.description: Abstract Errors-in-variables curves are curves where errors exist not only in the independent variable but also in the dependent variable. We address the challenge of constructing simultaneous confidence bands (SCBs) for such curves. Our method finds application in the Lorenz curve, which represents the concentration of income or wealth.

pmc-10636928.title: The relationship between parental health literacy levels and anthropometric measurements of children in Turkey
pmc-10636928.creator: Ozcan Aygun, Mine Topcu
pmc-10636928.description: ObjectiveThe aim of this study was to identify the relationship between parental health literacy levels and anthropometric measurements of children in Turkey.MethodsThe research was of cross-sectional/correlational design and carried out with 378 consenting parents registered at a Family Health Center. A Sociodemographic Data Form and the Health Literacy Scale for Turkey-32 was used to collect the study data.

pmc-10663140.title: Changes in cell wall composition due to a pectin biosynthesis enzyme GAUT10 impact root growth
pmc-10663140.creator: Linkan Dash, Sivakumar Swaminathan, Jan Šimura, Caitlin Leigh P Gonzales, Christian Montes, Neel Solanki, Ludvin Mejia, Karin Ljung, Olga A Zabotina, Dior R Kelley
pmc-10663140.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Arabidopsis (Arabidopsis thaliana) root development is regulated by multiple dynamic growth cues that require central metabolism pathways such as β-oxidation and auxin. Loss of the pectin biosynthesizing enzyme GALACTURONOSYLTRANSFERASE 10 (GAUT10) leads to a short-root phenotype under sucrose-limited conditions. The present study focused on determining the specific contributions of GAUT10 to pectin composition in primary roots and the underlying defects associated with gaut10 roots.

pmc-11396627.title: Interleukin 16 and 25 (IL-17E) and Clinical Outcomes in Exacerbation of COPD—A Pilot Study
pmc-11396627.creator: Tomasz Karauda, Joanna Miłkowska-Dymanowska, Anna Kumor-Kisielewska, Wojciech J. Piotrowski, Adam J. Białas
pmc-11396627.description: Background: Exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (ECOPD) significantly impact health status, hospitalization rates, and disease progression, and are linked to increased mortality. Predictive factors for ECOPD are therefore of considerable interest. The limited understanding of interleukin 16 (IL-16) and IL-25 role in ECOPD provided the rationale for this study.

pmc-11434680.title: Importance of Media Composition and Explant Type in Cannabis sativa Tissue Culture
pmc-11434680.creator: Rekhamani Das, Tobias Kretzschmar, Jos C. Mieog
pmc-11434680.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Producing uniform Cannabis sativa (Cannabis) for medicinal/recreational flower production through sexual propagation has been problematic, leading to dominance of clonal propagation from “mother plants” in the cannabinoid industry, which also faces significant limitations. Cannabis tissue culture (TC) methods have been developed to overcome these challenges, but the long-term health and maintenance of Cannabis explants in TC have been largely overlooked in previous studies.

pmc-11512870.title: Endoscopic screening for identification of signet ring cell gastric cancer foci in carriers of germline pathogenic variants in CDH1
pmc-11512870.creator: Lady Katherine Mejia Perez, Margaret O’Malley, Arjun Chatterjee, Ruishen Lyu, Qijun Yang, Michael W. Cruise, Lisa LaGuardia, David Liska, Carole Macaron, R. Matthew Walsh, Carol A. Burke
pmc-11512870.description: To determine the preoperative detection of signet ring cancer cells (SRC) on upper endoscopy (EGD) in patients with CDH1 pathogenic variant (PV) undergoing gastrectomy. To evaluate the development of advanced diffuse gastric cancer (DGC) in patients choosing surveillance. Guidelines recommend prophylactic total gastrectomy (pTG) in CDH1 PV carriers with family history of DGC between 18 and 40 years.

pmc-11790654.title: Unlocking autism’s complexity: the Move Initiative’s path to comprehensive motor function analysis
pmc-11790654.creator: Ashley Priscilla Good, Elizabeth Horn
pmc-11790654.description: The long-standing practice of using manualized inventories and observational assessments to diagnose and track motor function in autism overlooks critical data invisible to the naked eye. This subjective approach can introduce biases and hinder the translation of research into clinical applications that rely on objective markers of brain–body connections.

pmc-12369514.title: Regarding: ‘Optimizing recovery in orthognathic surgery: the cohort study of impact of rocuronium–sugammadex on extubation and perioperative outcomes’
pmc-12369514.creator: Yu-Ting Lin, Chih-Fan Chen, Ming-Hui Hung
pmc-12369514.description: erning inconsistencies in the reporting of key outcome data, which preclude a clear interpretation of the study’s results and conclusions. The most troubling inconsistency pertains to the data for postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV). Before propensity score matching, the rocuronium/sugammadex group (n = 77) is reported to have 15 PONV cases (19.5%).

pmc-12534824.title: High mesh density flow diversion of upper basilar artery aneurysms: Experience in 23 cases
pmc-12534824.creator: Jessica K Campos, Jonathan C Collard de Beaufort, Fahad J Laghari, Kimberlee A Van Orden, Melinda C Arthur, David A Zarrin, Benjamen M Meyer, Gizal A Amin, Narlin B Beaty, Matthew T Bender, Shuichi Suzuki, Geoffrey P Colby, Alexander L Coon
pmc-12534824.description: BackgroundFlow diversion has proven feasible for treating posterior circulation aneurysms. These studies, however, are limited to the utilization of low-mesh density devices. The high-mesh density and mesh geometry of the Surpass Evolve and Streamline flow diverters theoretically allow increased flow diversion while preserving perforators, a critical consideration in posterior circulation flow diversion.

pmc-12612689.title: Body Mass Index and Hypoglossal Nerve Stimulation Outcomes: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-12612689.creator: Coleton Evans, Benjamin Winters, Sandeep Rao, Sean Kelso, Peter Wickwire
pmc-12612689.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). pmc-12849504.title: Incident hypertension among adults on ART in Malawi: a nested cohort study
pmc-12849504.creator: Osward M Nyirenda, Brewster Moyo, Titus Divala, Andrea Buchwald, Nginache Nampota, Randy Mungwira, Wongani Nyangulu, Felix Mkandawire, Edson Mwinjiwa, Jane Mallewa, Matthew B Laurens, Miriam K Laufer, Joep J van Oosterhout
pmc-12849504.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionAs populations on antiretroviral therapy (ART) in sub-Saharan Africa are aging, hypertension has become an increasingly important comorbidity among people living with HIV (PLHIV). To address a paucity of data from sub-Saharan Africa on the incidence of hypertension among PLHIV, we conducted a cohort study in Malawi to assess the frequency and correlates of incident hypertension among PLHIV established on ART.MethodsIn this prospective cohort study nested in a clinical trial, we followed participants without prevalent hypertension at enrolment and routinely screened their

pmc-12972325.title: EJNMMI research: a vision for the next era of nuclear medicine
pmc-12972325.creator: Marcus Hacker
pmc-12972325.description: Irene Burger, and her editorial team for their sustained commitment to scientific rigor and for elevating the journal’s quality and international visibility. Nuclear medicine is entering a decisive decade. It provides medicine with a new language—the language of living biology—by visualizing and quantifying molecular processes in vivo, in real time, and across the entire body.

pmc-13108219.title: The Many Faces of SetDB1
pmc-13108219.creator: Stanislav E. Romanov, Dmitry E. Koryakov
pmc-13108219.description: The conserved protein SetDB1 has been identified in various vertebrate and invertebrate groups. It plays key roles in vital processes such as germline and nervous system development, immune response, tumorigenesis, cell cycle progression, and others. SetDB1 is initially characterized as an enzyme that methylates lysine 9 on histone H3, leading to gene silencing, which is traditionally considered its primary function.

pmc-13156371.title: Copper-doped zinc oxide nanoparticles as efficient antimicrobial agents: bridging electronic properties with biological properties
pmc-13156371.creator: Sultan Saad Almadhhi, Anuj Kumar, Mohd Ubaidullah, Kholnazarov Bakhodir Azamovich, Toshkulov A Kh, Aziz Baxtiyorovich Ibragimov, Abdullah M Al-Enizi
pmc-13156371.description: Zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs) have already shown potential applications as antimicrobial agents. However, the large band gap and charge carrier recombination of ZnO NPs reduce the production of reactive oxygen species, which limits their antibacterial activity; therefore, further modifications of their structural and electronic properties are required.

pmc-13237146.title: Biomarker, treatment patterns, and survival differences in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer by race in the United States
pmc-13237146.creator: Pegah Farrokhi, Leah Park, Howard Weston Schmutz, Samantha L Thompson, Clara Lam, Julian Bryan, David D Stenehjem
pmc-13237146.description: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) disproportionately affects Black women, with higher incidence rates and worse outcomes compared with White women. This study included 670 adult patients with metastatic TNBC diagnosed between January 2017 and March 2022 from the Flatiron Clinico-Genomic database.

pmc-13390289.title: ZNF831 suppresses triple-negative breast cancer progression through NLRP3-associated pyroptotic signaling and M1-like macrophage phenotypic remodeling
pmc-13390289.creator: Qingqing Liu, Jun Fan, Wantao Peng, Shuangwu Deng, Yupei Tan, Fei Guo, Jiangxue Zhong, Shimeng Zhou, Wenbin Liu, Yan Xu
pmc-13390289.description: BackgroundTriple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) remains difficult to treat because of poor immunogenicity and an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME). Pyroptotic signaling can enhance antitumor immunity through inflammatory cytokine release, but upstream regulators linking this process to macrophage phenotypic remodeling in TNBC remain incompletely understood.

pmc-13621211.title: Regioselective epoxidation of a polyunsaturated fatty acid by a vanadyl complex with redox-active ligands
pmc-13621211.creator: Andrew G. Hill, Tiffany Y.-C. Tang, Christina M. Knight, Kaitlyn S. Engle, Maximilian G. Bernbeck, Jake D. Soper, Aditi Das
pmc-13621211.description: Reaction of docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) with the oxovanadium complex [(Phisq)(Phibq)V(O)Cl] produces exclusively 19,20-epoxydocosapentaenoic acid (19,20-EDP). Computations reveal that the observed regioselectivity is not attributable to thermodynamics. New vanadyl analogs [(dippisq)(dippibq)V(O)Cl] and [(dippisq)2V(O)] were synthesized and showed no selectivity in DHA epoxidation.

pmc-13662409.title: Evaluation of early C‐reactive protein kinetics as an early response marker in biliary tract cancer treated with combined chemoimmunotherapy: A multicenter observational study
pmc-13662409.creator: Gabriel Allo, Joshua Leutiger, Catherine Leyh, Christian Möhring, Ann‐Kristin Zöller, Vera Himmelsbach, Gianluca Ciarlo, Maryam Barsch, Christoph Neumann‐Haefelin, Bertram Bengsch, Fabian Finkelmeier, Mohamad Murad, Cennet Sahin, Marie‐Luise Berres, Maria A. Gonzalez‐Carmona, Christoph Roderburg, Ar
pmc-13662409.description: BackgroundReliable prognostic biomarkers for treatment response in patients with biliary tract cancer (BTC) who receive chemoimmunotherapy are still lacking. The objective of this study was to evaluate the potential of early C‐reactive protein (CRP) kinetics as a tool for predicting survival in these patients.
